findings.statement: Dallas Against the Trump Agenda (DATA) coalition organized the Sept. 10, 2026 march from Pike Park toward the American Airlines Center during the RNC midterm convention.
Indivisible Dallas is publicly documented as a co-organizer; Sonja Olson is a documented public organizer/spokesperson for Indivisible Dallas.
We The People is reported as a coalition lead alongside Indivisible Dallas and runs a Sept. 10 evening rally at Dallas City Hall.
Dallas Voice names four partner groups: NAARPR DFW, DFW Anti-War Committee, El Movimiento, Freedom Road Socialist Organization.
The city canceled the coalition's special event permit days before the march; organizers proceeded anyway; police redirected the march and made two arrests.

data.method: Public open-source research: web search, news fetch (Dallas Morning News, Dallas Voice via meaws, Narativ, Fox News, Christian Post, Action Network, indivisibledallas.org, Mobilize), schema-checked StarIntel document creation via scripts/starintel.py import; Forward Observer briefing video preserved as operator-supplied pointer with 0.98 operator reliability.
